title: 第5章 这老登不会是觊觎我的身体吧第6章 任务奖励从哪来
content_zh:
翌日，楚墨睁开双眸，随着体内最后一缕真炁转化为丹霞一炁，《丹霞一炁洞玄经》转修成功。
“真炁质量上升了几个品质。”他陶醉的感受着新的力量，如果将原先的力量比作自行车，那如今就是开上了汽车。
可惜自己不会法术，无法实验一下功法真正的威力。
“想办法赚点法钱，弄几本法术才行。”
有道无术，在这度厄宗内就是行走的资粮。
楚墨目光一凝，突然警惕地看向房间角落。
“呵呵，小子你好像遇到点问题。”
一股黑气腾升而起，瞬间收拢成人形，黑袍兜帽的打扮，散发着阴冷的气息，使得周围温度都下降了几分。
【3级·弱小的阴灵（黄名）】
来人正是那日恐吓过新弟子的无名师兄。
“这位师兄，不知为何突然来找我？”
楚墨嘴上恭敬。心中则是暗骂一声，该死的破庭院，别人想进就进，一点防御措施都没有。
‘一定要弄一套阵法，不然以后睡觉都睡不安稳。’
黑袍人怪笑两声，“我名暮云，你称呼我为暮师兄就好。”
他身体轻若烟尘，绕着楚墨飘了两圈，不管对方的警惕之色，啧啧道：
“不知道你小子有什么本事，竟让江师兄特意给你安排了个能轻松赚法钱的生计。”
“什么？”楚墨哑然，怎么又有江云涯的影子。
“柳符师现在缺个辅佐处理杂事的童子，师兄向他推荐了你。”
暮云语气中带着艳羡，“这可是个好差事，运气好得到点有关制符的手艺，以后受益无穷。我当初咋没这运气呢？”
能不去吗？楚墨下意识的想拒绝，他与江云涯非亲非故，对方也不像是热心肠的人，怎么可能为他耗费心思。

但看到眼前不怀好意的暮云，楚墨低下头颅。势比人强，他已经拒绝过江云涯一次，要是再拒绝一次，引得对方不快，在这鬼宗门内被杀都没人主持公道。
......
柳符师是外门弟子，有一处自己的独立洞府。楚墨跟着暮云穿过门口的禁制，就看到一个面色苍白的青年在石案上画着什么。
【6级·度厄宗的杂兵】
‘咦？’楚墨心中泛起一丝惊讶，此人的血条竟然只有百分之二十，名称下面有一个暗红色的图标，样子类似抽象的火。
‘他就是柳衔？’楚墨猜测道。来的路上暮云已经说过关于这位符师的基础消息。
“柳符师，人已经带到。”暮云站住身形，恭敬的开口道。
柳衔没有理会，依旧专心的在石案上勾勒。
暮云不敢打扰对方，安静的在一旁等候。
大约半柱香后，柳衔才停笔，一股灼热的气息从石案向四周冲击，楚墨顿觉周围温度上升了几分。
“恭喜柳师兄技艺精进，这张【流火矢符】已有上品之相。”暮云走到石案旁观察片刻，开口赞叹道。
楚墨抬首看去，散发着些许腥味的红色染料旁，摆着一张画着抽象符号的符箓。大概就是对方口中的流火矢符。
content_en:
The next day, Chu Mo opened his eyes, and as the last ray of true energy in his body transformed into Danxia Yiqi, he successfully transformed into the "Danxia Yiqi Dong Xuan Jing".
"The quality of true Qi has increased by several qualities." He was intoxicated with the new power. If the original power was compared to a bicycle, it would now be like driving a car.
It's a pity that I don't know magic, so I can't test the true power of the technique.
"Find a way to make some magic money and get some magic books."
The Tao but not the skills is the foundation for walking in this Due Sect.
Chu Mo's eyes narrowed and he suddenly looked at the corner of the room warily.
"Haha, boy, you seem to have encountered some problems."
A burst of black energy rose up and instantly shrank into a human form. The black robe and hood exuded a cold aura, causing the surrounding temperature to drop a few points.
[Level 3·Weak Yin Spirit (yellow name)]
The person who came was none other than the unknown senior brother who had threatened the new disciples that day.
"This senior brother came to me suddenly for some reason?"
Chu Mo said respectfully. He cursed secretly in his heart, damn the courtyard is broken, others can enter if they want, without any defensive measures.
‘You must get a formation, otherwise you won’t be able to sleep well in the future. ’
The man in black robe laughed strangely, "My name is Mu Yun, you can just call me Senior Brother Mu."
His body was as light as smoke and dust, and he floated around Chu Mo twice. Regardless of the other party's vigilance, he clicked his tongue and said:
"I don't know what your kid's ability is, but you actually asked Senior Brother Jiang to specially arrange a livelihood for you where you can easily make legal money."
"What?" Chu Mo was dumbfounded, why was there the shadow of Jiang Yunya again.
"Master Liu Fu is currently in need of a boy to help with chores, and senior brother recommended you to him."
Mu Yun said with envy in his tone, "This is a good job. If you are lucky enough to get some skills in making talismans, you will benefit a lot in the future. Why didn't I have such luck in the first place?"
Can you not go? Chu Mo subconsciously wanted to refuse. He was not related to Jiang Yunya, and he didn't seem to be a warm-hearted person. How could he waste time on him.
But seeing Mu Yun with evil intentions in front of him, Chu Mo lowered his head. The power is stronger than the people. He has already refused to cross Jiang Yunya once. If he refuses again and makes the other party unhappy, no one will take justice for him in this ghost sect.
...
Master Liu Fu is an outer disciple and has his own independent cave. Chu Mo followed Mu Yun through the restriction at the door and saw a pale young man drawing something on the stone table.
[Level 6·Miscellaneous Soldiers of Duer Sect]
‘Huh? ’ Chu Mo felt a little surprised. This person’s health bar was only 20%. There was a dark red icon under his name, which looked like an abstract fire.
‘Is he Liu Xian? ’ Chu Mo guessed. On the way here, Mu Yun had already told some basic information about this Talisman Master.
"Master Liu Talisman, we have been brought here." Mu Yun stood still and said respectfully.
Liu Xian ignored it and continued to concentrate on sketching on the stone table.
Mu Yun did not dare to disturb the other party and waited quietly.
After about half a stick of incense, Liu Xian stopped writing. A hot breath rushed from the stone table to the surroundings. Chu Mo suddenly felt that the surrounding temperature had risen a bit.
"Congratulations to Senior Brother Liu for your improved skills. This [Flowing Fire Arrow Talisman] is already of the highest quality." Mu Yun walked to the stone table and observed it for a moment before praising.
Chu Mo looked up and saw a talisman with abstract symbols placed next to the red dye that exuded a slight fishy smell. It was probably the Flowing Fire Arrow Talisman mentioned by the other party.
